Welcome to Avets
When pets face serious, complex, or unexpected medical needs, Avets is here 24/7. Located just east of Pittsburgh, our emergency and specialty hospital brings together experienced ER clinicians, board-certified specialists, advanced technology, and a collaborative approach to providing exceptional care when it matters most.

Client Reviews & Testimonials
Our staff at Avets values feedback from our clients. Here is just a small sample of the hundreds of happy and healthy pets that we have cared for since 1994.
Everyone was so kind and caring when I took my Yorkie for an emergency visit.  They took her in quickly to assess and start the healing process.  The doctors were very thorough with options and I felt that they truly cared about the patients and the parents.  We fortunately had a success story and were able to bring her home after a 2 night stay.
Leslie L.
Avets were caring and very on top of things when we had an emergency with our lab.  He was almost dead from having his airway cut off.  They took care of him immediately and kept us informed all along the way.  Great Staff, Great Drs, compassion and professionalism.  Our guy has made a full recovery!
Kelly B.
You went in late on a Saturday night with our dog that was hit by a car. They immediately came out, took the dog back checked her out took care of her. She ended up staying there for three nights. The whole staff there was fantastic. I would recommend them any day. A little pricey, but probably comparable to everyone else. She is home on the mend and doing great
William L.
